record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.original_question: Can one write an explicit formula for the change in the Hodge-Deligne polynomial, or equivalently in favorable cases the Poincare polynomial, when crossing a critical value alpha_i in the wall-crossing of coherent-system moduli spaces?

evidence.quote: Question 8.8. Can one obtain an expression for the change in the Hodge-Deligne polynomial (or Poincaré polynomial) when crossing the critical value αi?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $C$ be a smooth irreducible complex projective curve of genus $g \geq 2$. A coherent system of type $(n,d,k)$ on $C$ is a pair $(E, V)$ where $E$ is a vector bundle on $C$ of rank $n$ and degree $d$, and $V \subseteq H^0(C, E)$ is a linear subspace of dimension $k$. For a real parameter $\alpha > 0$, the $\alpha$-slope of $(E,V)$ is
$$\mu_\alpha(E,V) = \frac{d}{n} + \alpha \frac{k}{n},$$
and $(E,V)$ is called $\alpha$-(semi)stable if for every proper coherent subsystem $(E',V') \subset (E,V)$ one has $\mu_\alpha(E',V') < \mu_\alpha(E,V)$ (resp. $\leq$). Let $G(\alpha; n,d,k)$ denote the moduli space of $\alpha$-stable coherent systems of type $(n,d,k)$. As $\alpha$ varies over the positive reals, the parameter range is divided by a finite (or in some ranges discrete) set of critical values $\alpha_1 < \alpha_2 < \cdots$ at which the moduli space changes; on the open intervals between consecutive critical values, the moduli space is constant up to isomorphism, denoted $G_i := G(\alpha; n,d,k)$ for $\alpha \in (\alpha_i, \alpha_{i+1})$.

For a quasi-projective complex variety $X$, let $E(X; u, v) = \sum_{p,q,k} (-1)^k h^{p,q}(H^k_c(X,\mathbb{C})) u^p v^q$ denote its Hodge–Deligne (E-) polynomial; in cases where $X$ has pure cohomology and is smooth projective, this specializes (up to substitution) to its Poincaré polynomial.

Provide an explicit closed-form formula, in terms of invariants of $C$ and of the type $(n,d,k)$, for the difference
$$E(G_i; u, v) - E(G_{i-1}; u, v)$$
arising from crossing a critical value $\alpha_i$ in the wall-crossing of moduli spaces of $\alpha$-stable coherent systems of type $(n,d,k)$ on $C$.
artifact.status_search_result: A general explicit formula for the change in the Hodge–Deligne (or Poincaré) polynomial of moduli spaces of coherent systems on curves when crossing a critical value $\alpha_i$ does not appear to be available in the literature. Partial results exist for specific small ranks or for dimension-one/order-one coherent systems, and there are seminars (e.g. at SISSA) on Hodge–Deligne polynomials of certain coherent system moduli, but no general wall-crossing formula has been established.

status_evidence.title: Variation of moduli spaces of coherent systems of dimension one and order one
status_evidence.snippet: Studies wall-crossing for special classes of coherent systems but does not provide general Hodge-Deligne wall-crossing formula.
status_evidence.claim: Wall-crossing of coherent systems is studied in restricted settings, with no general Hodge-Deligne polynomial formula given.

status_evidence.title: The Hodge-Deligne polynomials of some moduli spaces of coherent systems
status_evidence.snippet: Seminar on Hodge-Deligne polynomials of certain moduli spaces of coherent systems.
status_evidence.claim: Computations of Hodge-Deligne polynomials for some coherent system moduli are available, but only in special cases.
